text:
- Overall performance: Revenue after eliminations is $6.06 billion with a gross margin of 39.4% and EBITDA margin of 15.6%.
- The company that contributes most to revenue is Wipro GE Healthcare with $3.63 billion, while Wipro Kawasaki Precision Machinery needs attention with lower margins of 36% and 14% for gross and EBITDA respectively.
- Margins are 39.4% for gross and 15.6% for EBITDA, indicating a relatively stable profitability.
- Working capital as of 2025-12-01 is managed with 71 days of DSO and 80 days of DPO.
- Top 3 revenue drivers are: everything excluding profit centre EQ, revenue account Sales - Motors & Valves with $0.03 billion change (35% of total change), revenue account Sales - Motors & Valves excluding profit centre EQ with $0.02 billion change (25.9% of total change), and revenue account Sales - Hydraulic Pumps excluding profit centre EQ with $0.01 billion change (17.1% of total change).
